Es una pala que está pensada para jugadores avanzados o profesionales que prefieren un juego ofensivo, con golpes potentes, pero que también valoran un control eficaz en las transiciones.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA 

La ENEBE SPACE 2.0 2026 es una pala de formato híbrido-lágrima, con una superficie de golpeo amplia y muy cómoda para aumentar el control. Se ha Fabricado con carbono 12K en las caras y un núcleo Black EVA Pro con lo que destaca por su tacto firme y seco, ideal para responder con contundencia.

products.englishDescription:

The ENEBE SPACE 2.0 2026 returns in its 2026 version as a more powerful and aggressive racket, with a teardrop format and top-level 12K carbon. With a modern and daring design in blue tones, this racket attracts attention both for its aesthetics and for its behavior on the court.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a racket that is designed for advanced or professional players who prefer an offensive game, with powerful hits, but who also value effective control in transitions.

products.title: Munich Atmosphere - Palas De Padel

We present the MUNICH ATMOSPHERE, a racket designed with a modern touch, a combination of red, black and white that looks truly spectacular, making you want to have it in your hand all the time.

The MUNICH ATMOSPHERE is a racket designed for players looking for control, comfort and good sensations in each shot. Its construction combines accessible materials with technologies designed to facilitate play and improve performance on the court.

For the flats, we have Fiber glass 700, a very good fiberglass with great elasticity and resistance. Lastly, in terms of materials, its soft EVA rubber is the perfect rubber for good control and comfortable sensations.

products.description:
SIUX BEAT CONTROL 2026 - Increase control in all your matches with this new Siux 2026 racket. Oversized round format model, with greater balance to achieve a correct balance. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

This is the ideal padel racket for players who are starting out or have an average level who play occasionally. It is a padel racket that will meet all your demands on the court.

products.description:

It is a padel racket especially suitable for beginner and intermediate level players who want to start playing more regularly.

The NOX Start Gray EX JS 2026 maintains the same philosophy of the Start family: a racket that is easy to play, comfortable and designed so that we can focus on improving our technique. This is a version with a bolder design in gray.

products.description:
NOX ML10 PRO CUP ROUGH BY MIGUEL LAMPERTI 2027 - Retains the unmistakable character of the Pro Cup, but adds a rough surface for those who want to play more with spin. Round mold, large sweet spot, HR3 core and a comfortable touch that make it a very easy padel racket to enjoy.
*PRE-PURCHASE: IT WILL BE SHIPPED FROM OCTOBER 19* INTRODUCTION OF THE RACKET

The NOX ML10 PRO CUP ROUGH BY MIGUEL LAMPERTI 2027 puts a little twist on one of Miguel Lamperti's great classics. It maintains that comfortable, controllable feel that the Pro Cup is famous for, but adds relief to the faces to give the ball a little more play.

We find it to be a particularly attractive version for those who have always been a Pro Cup player, but want to take better advantage of sliced ​​shots, layups or vipers without abandoning the traditional feel of this model.

PLAYER TYPE

It is designed for players who seek control, comfort and ease of use, but who also enjoy varying effects during the point.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The NOX ML10 PRO CUP ROUGH BY MIGUEL LAMPERTI 2027 is a top racket, designed with the classic round mold of the ML10, providing a large sweet spot and combined with the HR3 rubber to achieve control and good ball response. It mounts aluminized fiberglass on the faces and carbon on the frame.

The big difference in this version is its rough surface, designed to give more prominence to the effects. In addition, it includes Smartstrap, which allows you to change the safety cord easily.

INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La espera ha valido la pena. Os presentamos la pala más potente de Middle Moon para la temporada 2026, el modelo MIDDLE MOON ATILA 3.0 12K 2026.

Modelo Premium en formato lágrima-diamante, fabricada en fibra de carbono 12K para ofrecer máxima potencia, firmeza y durabilidad.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Pensada para jugadores de experiencia y nivel avanzado, la ATILA 3.0 es perfecta para quienes buscan una pala exigente. Especialmente recomendada para jugadores de revés, que encontrarán un extra de potencia en su juego ofensivo.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Os vamos a contar todo lo nuevo que trae esta MIDDLE MOON ATILA 3.0 12K 2026.

Con un molde en forma de lágrima-diamante, este modelo garantiza golpes llenos de potencia y un rendimiento contundente en la pista. A pesar de su carácter ofensivo, mantiene un balance intermedio que le otorga gran maniobrabilidad y comodidad en cada golpe. Es algo que os va a gustar mucho de ella.

Fabricada en su totalidad con fibra de carbono 12K. Este material está comprobado que es uno de los compuestos más avanzados del sector y que más gusta a los jugadores, puesto que ofrece máxima resistencia, firmeza y un plus de durabilidad.

El tubular cuenta con la tecnología 2T TUBULAR, que añade un doble tubular de carbono, para que sea una pala ultra resistente.

Su núcleo interno tiene la famosa POWER EVA, una de las gomas más reactivas del mercado. Esta goma aporta un rebote increíble en cada golpe.

Otro aspecto destacado es su acabado rugoso total, presente en toda la superficie de la pala. Este tratamiento tipo arena favorece los efectos en cada golpe, aportando mayor rotación a la bola y dificultando la devolución de los rivales.

products.englishDescription:
MIDDLE MOON ATILA 3.0 12K 2026 - The MIDDLE MOON ATILA 3.0 12K 2026 arrives, a racket that stands out for its renewed aesthetics in white with gold details, providing an elegant and imposing style. This is a Premium model, created with top-level materials, where 12K carbon fiber stands out, responsible for providing great solidity and explosive performance when hitting. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The wait has been worth it. We present Middle Moon's most powerful racket for the 2026 season, the MIDDLE MOON ATILA 3.0 12K 2026 model.

Premium model in teardrop-diamond format, made of 12K carbon fiber to offer maximum power, firmness and durability.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for experienced and advanced level players, the ATILA 3.0 is perfect for those looking for a demanding padel racket. Especially recommended for backhand players, who will find extra power in their offensive game.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to tell you everything new that this MIDDLE MOON ATILA 3.0 12K 2026 brings.

With a teardrop-shaped diamond mold, this model guarantees powerful hits and powerful performance on the court. Despite its offensive nature, it maintains an intermediate balance that gives it great maneuverability and comfort with each hit. It is something that you are going to like a lot about it.

Made entirely with 12K carbon fiber. This material is proven to be one of the most advanced compounds in the sector and that players like the most, since it offers maximum resistance, firmness and extra durability.

The tubular has 2T TUBULAR technology, which adds a double carbon tubular, to make it an ultra-resistant racket.

Its inner core has the famous POWER EVA, one of the most reactive rubbers on the market. This rubber provides an incredible rebound in each hit.

Another notable aspect is its total rough finish, present on the entire surface of the blade. This sand-type treatment favors the effects of each shot, providing greater rotation to the ball and making it difficult for rivals to return.
